div.div: A planned stop hands the primary over before Valkey exits, so writes pause for about a second. An unplanned loss waits 5 s for Sentinel to be sure, then elects. Either way the pod comes back on its own node (local-path volumes are pinned) and rejoins as a replica; a node gone for good needs its PVC deleted.

text.tspan: A planned stop hands the primary over before Valkey exits, so writes pause for about a second. An unplanned loss waits 5 s for Sentinel to be sure, then elects. Either way the pod comes
back on its own node (local-path volumes are pinned) and rejoins as a replica; a node gone for good needs its PVC deleted.
